The tail mirror used W = Wt·mt with m = mt, so the tail was about 4× the reference instead of 2×. That is the 1.5× power error. I'll set the size per finger instead. Then I'll lower the gain a little with a shorter PMOS load length (Lp), so GBW/A clears 66 kHz.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Tail mirror double-scaled (W*mt and m=mt) gives ~36uA tail, so power fails. Use per-finger W. Halved current lowers GBW to ~30MHz, so gain must sit near 53-55 dB for f3db>=66k: shorten Lp to cut ro_p. Model updated to match."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "W1":   (40.0, 15.0, 80.0),
    "L1":   (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "Wc":   (12.0, 5.0, 40.0),
    "Lc":   (0.4, 0.3, 1.0),
    "Wp":   (16.0, 6.0, 50.0),
    "Lp":   (0.8, 0.3, 3.0),
    "Wt":   (15.0, 5.0, 30.0),
    "Lt":   (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "mt":   (2, 1, 3),
    "vcas": (1.0, 0.9, 1.2),
    "Rdiv": (1.8e6, 0.9e6, 4e6),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vdc = spec.get("vin_dc", spec.get("vcm", 0.75))
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    mt = int(round(p["mt"]))
    itail = mt * iref
    i1 = itail / 2

    Rt = p["Rdiv"]
    vcas = p["vcas"]
    R3 = Rt * vdc / vdd
    R2 = Rt * (vcas - vdc) / vdd
    R1 = Rt - R2 - R3
    idiv = vdd / Rt

    def solve_vgs(dev, W, L, I, vds, vsb=0.0):
        lo, hi = 0.1, 1.6
        for _ in range(40):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            if lut.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds, vsb)["Id"] > I:
                hi = mid
            else:
                lo = mid
        return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

    vs = 0.15
    for _ in range(4):
        vgs1 = solve_vgs('n', p["W1"], p["L1"], i1, 0.3, max(vs, 0.0))
        vs = vdc - vgs1
    vx = vcas - 0.7
    for _ in range(4):
        vgsc = solve_vgs('n', p["Wc"], p["Lc"], i1, 0.4, max(vx, 0.0))
        vx = vcas - vgsc
    vsgp = solve_vgs('p', p["Wp"], p["Lp"], i1, 0.9)
    vout = vdd - vsgp

    o1 = lut.op('n', p["W1"], p["L1"], vgs1, max(vx - vs, 0.05), max(vs, 0.0))
    oc = lut.op('n', p["Wc"], p["Lc"], vgsc, max(vout - vx, 0.05), max(vx, 0.0))
    op_ = lut.op('p', p["Wp"], p["Lp"], vsgp, vsgp)

    gm1 = o1["gm"]
    rout_n = (oc["gm"] / max(oc["gds"], 1e-12)) / max(o1["gds"], 1e-12)
    gout = op_["gds"] + 1.0 / rout_n
    A = gm1 / gout
    cpar = 1.5e-15 * p["Wp"] * p["Lp"] + 1e-15 * p["Wc"] + 20e-15
    ctot = cl + cpar
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * ctot)
    cmir = 2 * op_["cgg"] + 1e-15 * p["Wc"]
    fmir = op_["gm"] / (2 * PI * max(cmir, 1e-15))
    gbw = gbw / math.sqrt(1 + (gbw / fmir) ** 2) if fmir > 0 else gbw
    f3db = gbw / A
    power = vdd * (iref + itail + idiv)
    vmin = vx + 0.2
    vmax = vdd - 0.25
    swing = vmax - vmin

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MR", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wt"], p["Lt"])
    n.M("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wt"], p["Lt"], m=mt)
    n.R("R1", "vdd", "vcas", R1)
    n.R("R2", "vcas", "vref", R2)
    n.R("R3", "vref", "vss", R3)
    n.M("M1", "x1", "vin", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W1"], p["L1"])
    n.M("M2", "x2", "vref", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W1"], p["L1"])
    n.M("M3", "d1", "vcas", "x1", "vss", "nfet", p["Wc"], p["Lc"])
    n.M("M4", "vout", "vcas", "x2", "vss", "nfet", p["Wc"], p["Lc"])
    n.M("M5", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wp"], p["Lp"])
    n.M("M6", "vout", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wp"], p["Lp"])

    return n, {"gain_db": 20 * math.log10(max(A, 1e-3)), "gbw": gbw, "f3db": f3db,
               "power": power, "vout_dc": vout, "swing": swing}
```
